name: PlantExpertVQA: Plant Disease Visual Question Answering Benchmark
description: PlantExpertVQA is a large-scale, expert-level multimodal benchmark for visual question answering in agricultural plant pathology, disease diagnosis, and treatment recommendation. Developed by Syed Nazmus Sakib et al. and hosted on Hugging Face, the benchmark features 765,186 question-answer pairs paired with 150,841 leaf images across diverse crops and conditions alongside an expert Disease Knowledge Base. Unlike static classification datasets, PlantExpertVQA evaluates the multi-step diagnostic reasoning, symptom identification, etiology understanding, and treatment recommendation capabilities of vision-language models.
